title: Cohomology sheaves of a Koszul-regular immersion
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes, locally generated near every point of $Z$ by a finite Koszul-regular sequence. Use the scheme, ideal, module pullback, derived category and internal Hom of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Let $C=i^*\mathcal I$, $N=\mathcal Hom(C,\mathcal O_Z)$ and let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant and equal to the stalk finrank of $C$, using [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every integer $q$, $H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))\cong i_*T^q$, where $T^q$ is the degree-$q$ term of [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] applied to $N,r$: it is zero for $q<0$, and the direct image of $\bigwedge^q(N|_{\{r=q\}})$ from the clopen rank-$q$ stratum for $q\geq0$. This asserts only sheaf isomorphisms, not an isomorphism of derived objects.
